changeSet.author: palunyach
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finance_categories ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_cards ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `date` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(19, 5) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '', account_id BIGINT NOT NULL, finance_category_id BIGINT,
CONSTRAINT account_expense_card_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
CONSTRAINT finance_category_expense_card_fk FOREIGN KEY (finance_category_id) REFERENCES finance_categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS income_cards ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, `date` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(19, 5) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT '', account_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT account_income_card_fk FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE )
